method: Visual inspection of 18 extracted still frames; this is a coarse visual timeline, not exact event onsets and not an audio identification.

observations.visual: Grey rainbow/checker picture with a small colored reveal patch; four black/white buckets waiting below the belt.
Full-color picture revealed. Shovel near lower-left funnel; black/white lids/buckets are in opening animation. No sand on belt.
Shovel cutting the checker portion; black and white sand descending into funnel. Belt begins receiving sand.
Checker sand continues falling; black and white grains on belt and buckets filling.
Checker portion cleared; remaining black/white grains circulate and finish filling buckets.
Second wave visible: purple/cyan/lime/orange/pink buckets. Shovel cuts purple strip.
Purple removed; shovel cuts cyan strip; purple/cyan grains circulate and fill buckets.
Shovel cuts lime strip; cyan and lime grains enter belt.
Shovel cuts orange strip. Lime bucket label reaches 0 with detached lid immediately above it, showing a completion/closure animation.
Shovel cuts pink strip; orange grains on belt; bucket stacks reduce as filled buckets leave.
Pink strip is gone and its last grains drain along funnel/belt into remaining pink buckets.
Third wave visible: red/yellow/green/blue bucket stacks. Shovel cuts blue strip.
Blue gone; shovel cuts green strip; blue grains circulate below.
Green gone; shovel cuts yellow strip; green/yellow grains fill remaining stacks.
Only red strip remains, being cut; yellow completion visible below.
Picture completely empty; last red sand drains into final red bucket stack.
Dimmed gameplay with Sand Drop logo, app icon, and Play Now button (end card).

coarseRanges.event: Black/white checker clearing and bucket fill; transition to next wave occurs between sampled frames 8 and 12.
Purple, cyan, lime, orange, pink clearing; repeated bucket completion/closure.
Blue, green, yellow, red clearing and final drain.
Completion-to-end-card transition lies somewhere in this unsampled interval.

limits: No failure overlay or fail event is visible in these stills.
Exact lid hits, bucket flings, shovel input onsets, and end-card onset require denser frame sampling.
No audio claims were made from the visuals.
